description: Show whether the user is logged in to ShipSafe, their plan, and remaining AI scan quota. Use this to check if AI deep analysis is available before scanning.
name: shipsafe_status

aiScans.description: The AI-scan allowance, when it could be fetched.

lifetime.description: The plan's allowance never renews (free, Pro Audit).

remaining.description: Everything left, purchased scans included; -1 = unlimited.

email.description: The account's email, when logged in.

loggedIn.description: Whether a ShipSafe login is saved on this machine.

plan.description: The plan's name as sold: Free, Solo, Shield, Growth or Pro Audit.

quotaRefreshed.description: False when the quota could not be fetched (not logged in, or offline).

title: Show ShipSafe login + scan quota
